description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelDetailViewLink class, which extends SugarWidgetField, and provides functionality to generate HTML links for related records in a subpanel detail view within SuiteCRM. It handles link generation with respect to permissions, record and module specifics, and special handling for email records.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelDetailViewLink
classes.description: A widget class responsible for rendering detail view links in subpanels for related records.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to a detailed view of a related record in a subpanel, considering permissions, record status, and special cases such as emails.
